items.title: 20th Rozgar Mela held, over 51,000 appointment letters distributed
items.content:
सितंबर 2026 में रोजगार मेले का 20वां संस्करण आयोजित किया गया, जिसमें 51,000 से अधिक नियुक्ति पत्र वितरित किए गए।
The 20th edition of the Rozgar Mela was held in September 2026, where more than 51,000 appointment letters were distributed to newly recruited youth.
keyPoints: 20th edition of Rozgar Mela held in September 2026
Over 51,000 appointment letters distributed
About 12.75 lakh youth have received appointment letters through Rozgar Mela so far

items.title: 'Gondhal' (Marathi) selected as India's official entry for Oscars 2027
items.content:
'गोंधळ' (मराठी) को 99वें अकादमी पुरस्कार (Oscars 2027) में Best International Feature Film श्रेणी के लिए भारत की आधिकारिक प्रविष्टि चुना गया है। इसके निर्देशक संतोष डावखर हैं।
'Gondhal' (Marathi) has been selected as India's official entry for the Best International Feature Film category at the 99th Academy Awards (Oscars 2027). It is directed by Santosh Davakhar.
keyPoints: Marathi film 'Gondhal' is India's official Oscar 2027 entry
Category: Best International Feature Film, 99th Academy Awards
Director: Santosh Davakhar

items.title: Manu Bhaker and Pawan Sehrawat named India's flag bearers at 20th Asian Games
items.content:
मनु भाकर और पवन सहरावत 20वें Asian Games के उद्घाटन समारोह में भारत के ध्वजवाहक थे।
Manu Bhaker and Pawan Sehrawat were the flag bearers for India at the opening ceremony of the 20th Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.
keyPoints: Manu Bhaker and Pawan Sehrawat were India's flag bearers
20th Asian Games held in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan

items.title: Amul named official sponsor of Indian contingent for 2026 Asian Games
items.content:
Amul को 2026 Asian Games के लिए भारतीय दल का आधिकारिक प्रायोजक बनाया गया है।
Amul has been made the official sponsor of the Indian contingent for the 2026 Asian Games.
keyPoints: Amul is the official sponsor of India's contingent at the 2026 Asian Games

items.title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, 15, is youngest athlete in India's Asian Games contingent
items.content:
वैभव सूर्यवंशी, 15 वर्ष की आयु में, 2026 Asian Games में भारतीय दल के सबसे युवा एथलीट हैं।
Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, aged 15, is the youngest athlete in the Indian contingent at the 2026 Asian Games.
keyPoints: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi (15) is the youngest athlete in India's 2026 Asian Games contingent

items.title: India-born cheetah KGP-12 gives birth to four cubs at Kuno National Park
items.content:
भारत में जन्मी मादा चीता KGP-12 ने Kuno National Park में चार शावकों को जन्म दिया है।
The India-born female cheetah KGP-12 recently gave birth to four cubs in Kuno National Park.
keyPoints: Cheetah KGP-12 (India-born) gave birth to 4 cubs
Location: Kuno National Park, Madhya Pradesh

items.title: CBDT amends Income Tax Rule 225, removes arrest/detention provisions for tax defaulters
items.content:
CBDT ने Income Tax Rules के Rule 225 में संशोधन कर कर बकाएदारों की गिरफ्तारी और हिरासत संबंधी प्रावधानों को समाप्त कर दिया है।
The CBDT amended Rule 225 of the Income Tax Rules, eliminating provisions related to the arrest and detention of tax defaulters.
keyPoints: CBDT amended Rule 225 of Income Tax Rules
Arrest and detention provisions for tax defaulters removed

items.title: Hamirpur (HP) records highest female LFPR at 80.9% in first district-level PLFS data
items.content:
पहले जिलास्तरीय PLFS आंकड़ों के अनुसार, Hamirpur, Himachal Pradesh में महिला LFPR सर्वाधिक 80.9% दर्ज की गई।
According to the first district-level PLFS data, Hamirpur, Himachal Pradesh recorded the highest female LFPR at 80.9%.
keyPoints: First district-level PLFS data released
Hamirpur, Himachal Pradesh recorded highest female LFPR at 80.9%

items.title: Moody's raises India's FY2026-27 GDP growth forecast to 7%
items.content:
Moody's Ratings ने वित्त वर्ष 2026-27 के लिए भारत की GDP वृद्धि दर का अनुमान बढ़ाकर 7% कर दिया है।
Moody's Ratings has raised India's GDP growth forecast for FY 2026-27 to 7%.
keyPoints: Moody's raised India's FY2026-27 GDP growth forecast to 7%

items.title: HAL hands over LCA Tejas twin-seater trainer and HTT-40 to Indian Air Force
items.content:
Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) ने बेंगलुरु में भारतीय वायुसेना को LCA Tejas twin-seater trainer और HTT-40 basic trainer aircraft सौंपे।
Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) handed over the LCA Tejas twin-seater trainer and HTT-40 basic trainer aircraft to the Indian Air Force in Bengaluru.
keyPoints: HAL handed over LCA Tejas twin-seater trainer to IAF
HTT-40 basic trainer aircraft also handed over
Handover took place in Bengaluru

items.title: Jos Buttler becomes first batsman to complete 15,000 T20 runs
items.content:
Jos Buttler (England) टी20 क्रिकेट के इतिहास में 15,000 रन पूरे करने वाले दुनिया के पहले बल्लेबाज बने हैं।
Jos Buttler (England) has become the first batsman in the world to complete 15,000 runs in the history of T20 cricket.
keyPoints: Jos Buttler (England) is the first batsman to reach 15,000 T20 runs

items.title: L&T Semiconductor Technologies and Tata Electronics form strategic partnership
items.content:
L&T Semiconductor Technologies और Tata Electronics ने सेमीकंडक्टर चिप्स के स्वदेशी उत्पादन को बढ़ाने के लिए रणनीतिक साझेदारी की है।
L&T Semiconductor Technologies and Tata Electronics have formed a strategic partnership to expand indigenous semiconductor chip production.
keyPoints: L&T Semiconductor Technologies and Tata Electronics partner for semiconductor chip production

items.title: Qdenga becomes India's first approved dengue vaccine
items.content:
Qdenga, जिसे Takeda ने विकसित किया है और भारत में Dr. Reddy's Laboratories द्वारा विपणन किया जाता है, भारत की पहली स्वीकृत डेंगू वैक्सीन है।
Qdenga, developed by Takeda and marketed in India by Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, is India's first approved dengue vaccine.
keyPoints: Qdenga is India's first approved dengue vaccine
Developed by Takeda, marketed in India by Dr. Reddy's Laboratories

items.title: 'Kishore Kumar: The Ultimate Biography' wins Best Book on Cinema at 70th National Film Awards
items.content:
'Kishore Kumar: The Ultimate Biography' ने 70वें National Film Awards में Best Book on Cinema का पुरस्कार जीता। इसके लेखक Anirudha Bhattacharjee और Parthiv Dhar हैं।
'Kishore Kumar: The Ultimate Biography' won the Best Book on Cinema award at the 70th National Film Awards. It was authored by Anirudha Bhattacharjee and Parthiv Dhar.
keyPoints: 'Kishore Kumar: The Ultimate Biography' wins Best Book on Cinema, 70th National Film Awards
Authors: Anirudha Bhattacharjee and Parthiv Dhar
